_comment: Apple Shortcut spec — text representation. Import via the Shortcuts app on iPhone/iPad/Watch. Paste these actions into a new Shortcut named 'Tell Ralph'. Replace TAILSCALE_HOST with your Mac mini's Tailscale name (e.g. mac-mini.tailNNNNN.ts.net).
name: Tell Ralph
description: Dictate a thought; Ralph drops it in 00-Inbox/ for tomorrow's memory pass.
_install: 1. Open the Shortcuts app on your iPhone/iPad.
2. Tap '+' to create a new Shortcut.
3. Add the actions in order: Dictate Text → URL → Get Contents of URL (POST, Form, with `text` + `source` fields wired to Dictated Text) → Show Notification.
4. Replace TAILSCALE_HOST with your Mac mini's Tailscale name.
5. Name the shortcut 'Tell Ralph'. Add it to your Watch face for one-tap dictation.
6. Optional: 'Hey Siri, Tell Ralph' becomes the trigger on iPhone + AirPods.
7. To capture audio instead of dictation: replace 'Dictate Text' with 'Record Audio' and use the `audio` form field instead of `text`. Requires whisper-cli on the Mac mini.
